# Tripo AI models

`art/incoming/tribe3d/tripo/warrior_raw.glb` ("tribal female warrior 3d model") was generated by the owner in the Tripo AI app on 2026-11-17 and attached to the chat as a GLB. The same day the owner split it into parts in the Tripo app (Segment) and sent `art/incoming/tribe3d/tripo/warrior_split_raw.glb` (40 parts, a texture per part); `art/grind3d/huntress.glb` is our rigged, lighter version of THAT file (tools/blender/tripo_parts_rig.py), the hero of grind3d.html; `art/tribe3d/people/warrior_f.glb` (tools/blender/tripo_rig.py, from the first file) stays for tribe3d.html.

Licence: Tripo's terms depend on the account's plan (free-plan models are public, and Tripo has listed them under CC BY 4.0, i.e. credit "Tripo AI"; paid plans give private / commercial rights). The owner should check the plan in the app before the game is published anywhere; this repository is public. Credit line to use if needed: "3D model made with Tripo AI (tripo3d.ai)".
